sigma_purchase_spec.purpose: a paid source becomes THE sigma primary iff ALL six hold; pre-committed symmetric acceptance — including sigma >= 0.53 if that is what it shows
spec: 1 UNIT basis (transformer counts) — or value basis WITH both segments' $/unit disclosed so conversion is internal
2 class boundary stated and mappable to >=100 MVA (accept >=60 MVA with the class caveat carried; reject unbounded 'power transformers')
3 US market: purchases for US installation, imports included
4 utility vs non-utility partition summable from segments; the IPP/generation-developer classification MUST be stated (largest taxonomy risk — some houses count IPPs inside 'power/utilities')
5 annual 2021-2024 actuals (2025 snapshot + back-cast accepted only as a band, stated; late-2024 vintage preferred — hits the Dec-24 calibration point)
6 methodology note: ORDERS preferred (sigma is an order share); shipments accepted with the delivery-lag caveat (~the response term's dead time); installed-base REJECTED
sigma_purchase_spec.acceptance: meets 1-6 -> its band (stated uncertainty, else +-0.05) becomes the sigma primary, consumed emergent-matched; fails any -> joins the stack as corroboration only, purchase price notwithstanding
